name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
steps: Sit or stand tall and anchor one hand lightly behind your back or beneath your chair seat to depress that shoulder.
Turn your head roughly 45 degrees toward the opposite side and look down toward your armpit.
Rest your free hand gently on the back crown of your head to guide your chin slightly downward into a mild neck stretch.
Hold steadily while breathing calmly for the target duration, release slowly, and switch sides.
tips: Apply only gentle fingertip weight rather than pulling forcefully down on your head.
Keep the anchored shoulder relaxed and low throughout the entire stretch.
